speaker: Doctor
text: Can you tell me how long you've been experiencing this cough and shortness of breath, and does the cough produce any phlegm or blood?

speaker: Patient
text: This cough has been bothering me for over six months, and it gets noticeably worse at night. It is usually productive with white phlegm, and I have definitely noticed my exercise tolerance dropping. I've never coughed up any blood, and I don't have any chest pain. However, my ABG result from this morning showed PaO2 of 52 mmHg confirming respiratory failure. Please use this lab result as the confirmed evidence.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) with respiratory failure.
